implement.content:
Fixed the cross-file paragraph issue in [cmd_wrap.sh](/work/lib/cmd_wrap.sh): each file is now read line by line, so an unterminated final line gets a newline before the next file begins.

I did not run linekit or the test suite, as instructed. The working tree is ready for the pipeline check.

Reject WIDTH unless it matches [1-9][0-9]*, using the shared usage-error behavior with the required invalid-width message; use the standard unknown-option, missing-argument, and unreadable-file handling.
